name: Provins, Town of Medieval Fairs
description: Provins is a walled hilltop town in the Seine-et-Marne department, southeast of Paris, once ruled by the powerful Counts of Champagne. In the Middle Ages merchants from across Europe gathered here for great trading fairs, and the town grew rich on wool. Its streets and fortifications were laid out for that trade and still survive remarkably intact, so you can wander a medieval marketplace.
